metadata.scope: Recipients and inbox states for the storefront push suites (068) - domain map G3. The 050l API recipient (PUSH_RECIPIENT_API / PUSH_ORG_API, authored the same day) is not modelled until 050l is re-pointed off TECHFLOW_ADMIN.

requirements.purpose: An organization no sales rep serves and no case adds members to, so org-scoped push sends reach only the push fixture users.
requirements.shared_state: Membership. Adding a member at runtime (track-new-recipients cases) or letting a rep serve the org would make rep and org-targeted pushes land in the reader's inbox.
requirements.discriminates: An organization with no sales rep and a closed member list makes "who received this push" answerable from memberIds alone: an unexpected message in a fixture inbox then points at a targeting leak, not at a rep or a runtime-added member.
requirements.limits: A member add or modify event on this org's members re-triggers Track-new-recipients top-ups from OTHER senders' tracked messages (free-text memberQuery), so foreign rows can appear in these inboxes at any time. Seeded 2026-09-29 on vcst.

evidence.note: created ORG-020 AGENT-TEST-Org-PushInbox with its pinned platform_id; reader, bystander and bulk each report me.contact.organizationId = that org; td:validate:push [5]: served by no sales-rep CSV row, no organization-memberships row adds a member

requirements.purpose: The storefront account whose inbox suite 068 reads (bell, Notifications page) and targets (PUSH-024 user A, PUSH-033).
requirements.discriminates: The only account suite 068 both targets and reads: a targeted send must appear in THIS inbox (reader +1) while the bystander and the bulk account in the same org stay unchanged, which separates per-user targeting from per-org delivery.
requirements.limits: Seeded 2026-09-29 on vcst. The inbox also holds messages from other senders (tracked messages whose free-text memberQuery matches the account); those are not the fixture's and are never counted.

evidence.note: login created with an Approved Purchasing agent membership in AGENT-TEST-Org-PushInbox; password grant with storeId B2B-store returned 200 and me.memberId equals the aliases.vcst.json contactId

requirements.purpose: A member of the same organization as the reader that no memberIds ever names (068 PUSH-024 user B).
requirements.shared_state: Its inbox must stay free of targeted AGENT-TEST messages; an org-wide send would end that.
requirements.discriminates: Same organization as the reader, divergent inboxes: an org-scoped leak shows the reader's targeted message here (reader >= 1, bystander 0), so 'a customer reads only their own rows' is decidable. Two users in different orgs could not tell a per-user filter from a per-org one.
requirements.limits: targeted_messages counts AGENT-TEST rows and memberIds naming; foreign tracked messages (Track new recipients + a free-text memberQuery) also reach this account and are not a targeting leak. Seeded 2026-09-29 on vcst.

evidence.note: login created in AGENT-TEST-Org-PushInbox (token 200, storeId B2B-store); 0 AGENT-TEST rows in its inbox (hidden included) and no push message whose memberIds names its member id; 3 foreign rows from tracked messages of other senders

requirements.purpose: A separate recipient in the inbox org that absorbs mark-all-read and clear-all (068 PUSH-021, PUSH-029).
requirements.shared_state: Everything in its inbox ends read and hidden after each run.
requirements.discriminates: Keeps destructive bulk writes off the reader: after mark-all-read and clear-all the bulk inbox is all read and hidden while the reader still holds read AND unread messages, so the unread-count cases stay decidable in the same run.
requirements.limits: Seeded 2026-09-29 on vcst. The inbox also holds messages from other senders (tracked messages whose free-text memberQuery matches the account); those are not the fixture's and are never counted.

evidence.note: login created with an Approved Purchasing agent membership in AGENT-TEST-Org-PushInbox; password grant with storeId B2B-store returned 200 and me.memberId equals the aliases.vcst.json contactId

requirements.purpose: The reader's inbox holds at least 11 visible Sent AGENT-TEST messages, at least one read and at least one unread.
requirements.shared_state: Read flags: PUSH-019/022/036 each mark one message read and restore it. Never assert an exact count, and never run mark-all or clear-all against this inbox (that is data.push.recipient.bulk's job).

cleanup.via: Cannot be undone: a Sent message can be neither edited nor deleted (push.irrevocable). Isolated by the dedicated reader account in its own organization.

requirements.discriminates: unread != total makes 'the Notifications heading and the bell badge show the UNREAD count' (PUSH-020/036) and 'Show unread only' decidable; with every message unread the heading equals both counts and the case passes whichever it shows. 11 visible messages against a page size of 10 makes pagination (PUSH-018) decidable.
requirements.limits: seed:push reaches it by TOP-UP (counts the reader's visible AGENT-TEST rows, sends only the difference, keeps >= 1 read and >= 1 unread); a second run sends nothing. It counts only AGENT-TEST rows: tracked messages from other senders also land here (Track new recipients with a free-text memberQuery) and are never counted toward the thresholds. Authored 2026-09-29 by /qa-generate-data; seeded and verified live on vcst 2026-09-29.

requirements.purpose: The bulk recipient holds at least 3 visible unread messages sent in this run, before mark-all-read and clear-all consume them.

cleanup.via: Cannot be undone (irrevocable Sent messages); mark-all-read and clear-all are the consumption itself. Isolated by the dedicated bulk account.

requirements.discriminates: Fresh unread, visible messages give mark-all-read something to flip and clear-all something to hide; after a previous run the inbox is all read and all hidden, and both cases would pass on a no-op.
requirements.limits: Run PUSH-021 before PUSH-029 in the same run (clear-all hides what mark-all needs visible). Authored 2026-09-29 by /qa-generate-data; seeded and verified live on vcst 2026-09-29.

evidence.note: seed:push sent 3 fresh messages; all visible and unread to the bulk user within 4 s (batch_marker / batch_message_ids written to aliases.vcst.json)

requirements.purpose: A personal storefront account that no push message has ever targeted (068 PUSH-025).
requirements.shared_state: One targeted send ends the state for good: a Sent message cannot be deleted and clear-all only hides it, while the Notifications page lists hidden messages too. No case may target this account.
requirements.discriminates: Zero messages INCLUDING hidden ones is the only state that shows the empty-state text; an inbox emptied with clear-all still lists its messages on the page (push.manage.clear-all), so it cannot stand in.
requirements.limits: UNREACHABLE AS DESIGNED on vcst. Track new recipients adds any NEW member that matches a tracked message's memberQuery (domain map §1 link 7), and vcst holds 15 tracked Sent messages. Their free-text queries include "test", "Test User", "admin" and "new", so any AGENT-TEST / test-agent.com account matches "test" the moment it is created. seed:users therefore creates an account that is already non-empty. Resolution belongs to the fixture owner: an account whose name and email match none of the tracked queries (which conflicts with the AGENT-TEST naming the teardown sweep relies on), OR re-point PUSH-025 to a state that tolerates foreign tracked rows. Either way it stays fragile while anyone can create a new tracked message with a broad query. Replaces {{USER_EMAIL}}, which is empty today but is used by many suites and could receive a broadcast.

evidence.ref: npm run seed:users + npm run seed:push:verify (vcst) [L3]
evidence.note: seed:users created agent-test-push-empty@test-agent.com at 14:36Z; its inbox already held 1 message (pushMessages(withHidden: true).totalCount = 1): the Sent message 31ad4bc9 "Welcome", which has Track new recipients on and memberQuery "test". Creating the member triggered the recipient top-up. Sent messages cannot be edited or deleted, so this account cannot reach the required state again.

profiles.purpose: Reader's page and bell show body + timestamp, no topic.
Show unread only narrows a mixed inbox.
A message targeted at the reader never reaches the bystander in the same org.
A never-targeted account sees the empty state on the page and in the bell.
Mark one of the reader's unread messages read, then restore it.
Mark one of the reader's read messages unread, then restore it.
Mark all read on the bulk recipient's fresh messages.
Clear all on the bulk recipient: bell empties, page keeps listing.
The reader's open storefront receives a new message without reload.
